column1: # Covers 6 diverse priority group types across different sources and featuretypes.
# Groups are applied in order; first match wins.
# Use * to match any value in source or featuretype.
# Classical alleles — named point mutations and small deletions from forward screens
# Large-scale knockouts — knockout consortium and NBP library
# Million mutation project — EMS-mutagenised library, all featuretypes
# RNAi reagents — any source with featuretype RNAi_reagent (covers Fly, Worm, etc.)
# Transposable element insertions — structural variants from any source
# Exclude internal bookkeeping features not useful to end users
